title: 第14章 他想，他大概这辈子都逃不掉了
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
不知过了多久，叶闻白退开一些，与安怜额头相抵，气息交缠。

    “怜儿好乖。”他低声说，声音哑哑的，带着一丝克制的欲望。

    安怜脸更红了，连带着脖颈都红了一片。

    她偏过头，不敢看他。

    虽然她看不见，但她总觉得叶闻白的目光能穿透黑暗，看进她心里去。

    叶闻白喉间溢出低笑，吻了吻她的耳垂。

    安怜浑身一颤，缩了缩脖子。

    “哥哥，痒……”

    “嗯。”叶闻白应了一声，却没有停下来。

    他的吻顺着她的耳廓慢慢往下，落在她脖颈侧面。

    安怜呼吸一滞，身体有些僵硬。

    那块地方，有江彻留下的痕迹。

    叶闻白似乎也察觉到了什么，嘴唇贴在她皮肤上，没有动。

    空气忽然安静下来。

    安怜紧张得心脏都要跳出来了，脑子里疯狂运转，想找个什么借口解释。

    但叶闻白什么都没问。

    他只是在那一小块皮肤上轻轻啄了一口，然后继续往下。

    吻落在锁骨，落在锁骨下方的红痕上，落在那些深深浅浅的印记上。

    安怜被他吻得浑身发软，手指插进他的头发里，不知道该推开还是该抓紧。

    叶闻白没有给她思考的时间。

    他的吻一路往下，每一寸皮肤都不放过，仔细得像在描摹什么。

    安怜的呼吸越来越急促，手指攥紧他的头发，声音发颤：“哥哥……别……别亲……”

    叶闻白停下来，抬起头，在黑暗中看向她的脸。

    “怎么了？”他故意问道，声音低沉。

    安怜咬着唇，不知道该怎么说。

    总不能说“你别亲了，那些地方都是别的男人留下的痕迹”吧。

    那不是找死吗。

    “就是……痒。”她憋了半天，憋出这么一句。

    “嗯。”叶闻白应道。

    明明没有追问，却让安怜感受到了很强的压迫感。

    她想说些什么，但叶闻白没给她机会。

    他重新吻了上去，不再是一点一点地描摹，而是带着不容拒绝的力道。

    安怜被他吻得说不出话，只能发出一声声细碎的喘息。

    她的睡衣不知道什么时候被解开了，丝绸的面料滑到两边。

    夜风从窗户的缝隙吹进来，带起一阵凉意，但很快就被叶闻白滚烫的体温覆盖。
content_en:
After an unknown amount of time, Ye Wenbai stepped back a little and touched An Lian's forehead, their breaths intertwined.

    "Lian'er is so good." He whispered, his voice hoarse, with a trace of restrained desire.

    An Lian's face turned redder, and even her neck turned red.

    She tilted her head, not daring to look at him.

    Although she couldn't see it, she always felt that Ye Wenbai's eyes could penetrate the darkness and see into her heart.

    Ye Wenbai laughed softly and kissed her earlobe.

    An Lian trembled all over and shrank her neck.

    "Brother, it's itchy..."

    "Yes." Ye Wenbai responded, but did not stop.

    His kiss slowly went down the shell of her ear and landed on the side of her neck.

    An Lian's breathing was stagnant and her body was a little stiff.

    There are traces left by Jiang Che in that place.

    Ye Wenbai seemed to have noticed something, his lips were pressed against her skin without moving.

    The air suddenly became quiet.

    An Lian was so nervous that her heart almost jumped out of her chest, and her mind was running wildly, trying to find some excuse.

    But Ye Wenbai didn't ask anything.

    He just pecked the small patch of skin and moved on.

    The kiss fell on the collarbone, on the red marks under the collarbone, on those deep and shallow marks.

    An Lian was so kissed that her whole body went limp. Her fingers were inserted into his hair, and she didn't know whether to push it away or hold on tightly.

    Ye Wenbai didn't give her time to think.

    His kiss went all the way down, not sparing every inch of skin, as carefully as if he was tracing something.

    An Lian's breathing became faster and faster, her fingers clenched his hair tightly, and her voice trembled: "Brother... don't... don't kiss..."

    Ye Wenbai stopped, raised his head, and looked at her face in the darkness.

    "What's wrong?" he asked deliberately, his voice low.

    An Lian bit her lip, not knowing what to say.

    You can't say, "Stop kissing me. Those places are all traces left by other men."

    Isn't that seeking death?

    "It's just... itchy." She held it in for a long time before saying this.

    "Yeah." Ye Wenbai responded.

    Although she didn't ask further questions, An Lian felt a strong sense of oppression.

    She wanted to say something, but Ye Wenbai didn't give her a chance.

    He kissed her again, no longer tracing it bit by bit, but with a force that could not be refused.

    An Lian was speechless by his kiss and could only let out small gasps.

    Her pajamas were untied at some point, and the silk fabric slipped to both sides.

    The night breeze blew in through the cracks in the window, bringing a chill, but it was quickly covered by Ye Wenbai's hot body temperature.
title_en: Chapter 14 He thought that he might never be able to escape in this life
